goal: Find Mac model name and serial number

steps.title: Open About This Mac
steps.explanation: Click the Apple menu in the top-left corner, then choose About This Mac. The window shows your Mac's model name and serial number.

steps.title: Open System Information
steps.explanation: Hold the Option key, click the Apple menu, and choose System Information. Then click Hardware in the sidebar to see your serial number and model details.

steps.title: Open account.apple.com
steps.explanation: On any device, go to account.apple.com and sign in. Click Devices, then click your Mac's name to see its model name and serial number.

steps.title: Find serial number with a Terminal command
steps.explanation: This command reads your Mac's serial number and shows it in the results. It only reads information and changes nothing.

steps.title: Check the label on your Mac
steps.explanation: Turn your Mac over or look at its original box. The serial number is printed near the regulatory markings or next to a barcode.

steps.title: Look up the model name online
steps.explanation: Go to checkcoverage.apple.com and enter your serial number. It will show the exact model name of your Mac.
